request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

mapping: Target rows are observed directly at compute_logits input.
MTP first pass indexes last_hidden_states by first_step_sample_indices.
Remaining MTP pass indexes by arange[:batch_size]; two steps are fixed by launch configuration.
Pinned Qwen35 admission requires draft greedy and rejects lmhead_tp; normal logits path still applies the full local head before reduced sampling.
TP vocabulary partitions are combined once, not multiplied again by duplicated metadata.
limitations: Draft rows are inferred from pinned source and graph replay inputs, not observed inside graph kernels.
This is matrix semantic accounting (2*M*N*K), not measured hardware instruction arithmetic.
Padding, logits gathering, argmax, sampling and other model operators are excluded.
